package.name: PartDesign Add-ins
package.description: Extra PartDesign features. Rail Pipe / Rail Groove: sweep a flat face or closed sketch along a guide curve to a second profile or a free end, added to or cut out of the Body; edit the guide on screen with a Move gizmo, cable-like neighbours and the native PartDesign preview.

workbench.name: PartDesign Add-ins
workbench.description: Rail Pipe / Rail Groove; the tools also appear in PartDesign's Modeling Features toolbar.
